trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَنْتَ سَيِّدِيْ جَبَّارٌ غَفَّارٌ قَادِرٌ قَاهِرٌ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ غَافِرُ الذَّۢنْبِ وَقَابِلُ التَّوْبِ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ‌ فَالِقُ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوٰى مُوْلِجُ اللَّيْلِ فِي النَّهَارِ وَمُوْلِجُ النَّهَارِ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَمُخْرِجُ الْحَيِّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتِ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَرَازِقُ الْعِبَادِ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا جَبَّارُ صَلِ‌ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاعْفُ عَنِّيْ وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ۔

lines.rarabic: ANTA SAYYA-DEE JABBAA-ROON GHAFFAA-ROON QAADE-ROON QAAHE-ROON SAMEE-OO’N A’LEE-MOON GHAFOO-RUR RAHEE-MOON GHAAFE-RUZ ZAMBE WA QAABE-LUT TAWBE SHADEE-DUL E’QAA-BE FAALE-QUL HABBE WAN NAWAA MOOLE-JUL LAIY-LE FIN-NAHAARE WA MOLE-JUN NAHAARE FIL-LAIY-LE WA MUKH-RE-JUL HAIYYE MINAL MAIYYE-TE WA MUKH-RE-JUL MAIYYE-TE MINAL HAIYYE WA RAAZE-QUL E’BAA-DE BE-GHAIYRE HESAA-BIN YAA JABBAA-RO, YAA JABBAA-RO, YAA JABBAA-RO, YAA JABBAA-RO, YAA JABBAA-RO, YAA JABBAA-RO, YAA JABBAA-RO SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA’FO A’NNEE WAGH-FIR-LEE WAR-HAMNEE INNA-KA ANTAL GHAFOO-RUR RAHEEMO.

trans.en: O my Master! You are the Compeller! Forgiver! Powerful! Subduer! All-Hearing! All-Knowing! All-Forgiving! O Merciful! O Forgiver of sins! O Acceptor of repentance! O Strict in punishment! The One who splits grains and seeds! O He who merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night. O He who brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living. Provider of sustenance for the people without measure. O Compeller! O Compeller! O Compeller! O Compeller! O Compeller! O Compeller! O Compeller! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s). Please pardon me, forgive me and have mercy on me as You are All-Forgiving, Merciful!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
